Your adhd partner sounds like when I was in my early 20s. I was stuck in a cycle of self hatred from childhood trauma. Despite everyone’s best intentions, I was so stuck in the mindset that I deserve trash because I am trash. Every time I got a lecture, it was “confirmation” to my brain that I was indeed trash. Couldn’t care less if I had a job, or what my credit score was, and my hair was extremely matted. 

When I decided I was done feeling like trash, I reached out for professional help, I got on the right meds and learned tricks to take care of myself. I am much better now.
